verified: The EU has adopted a provisional cap allowing up to 191,780 China-made hybrid and plug-in hybrid passenger cars into the bloc from 1 December 2026 to 18 June 2027 — the 200-day period — as reported by carnewschina.com, Bloomberg and auto.mail.ru. Bloomberg reports the measure is temporary while the EU carries out a probe that is expected to lead to longer-term restrictions.
unconfirmed: The reports give no detail on the parallel restrictions on hybrid imports from countries other than China — which countries are covered, at what volumes, or how those limits are calculated. auto.mail.ru describes plug-in hybrids as the main target, while carnewschina.com says the cap covers both hybrids and plug-in hybrids; no source details how the quota is allocated among manufacturers or how it will be enforced.

verified: 欧盟对从中国进口的混合动力乘用车实施临时进口配额，上限为 191,780 辆，实施期为 200 天，即 2026 年 12 月 1 日至 2027 年 6 月 18 日；相关措施同时限制来自其他国家的混合动力车进口（electrive 报道，Bloomberg、carnewschina 等亦作此报道）。
unconfirmed: 配额如何在车企之间分配、具体涵盖哪些车型（普通混动与插电式混动的比例）、对“其他国家”的限制范围与力度，以及 2027 年 6 月 18 日之后的安排，均未见于现有报道；Bloomberg 称该配额为临时措施，欧盟正进行一项调查，最终可能实施为期数年的长期限制，但调查结论与后续方案尚未公布。

titles.en: EU sets 200-day quota capping Chinese hybrid car imports at 191,780
titles.zh: 欧盟对华混合动力车设200天进口配额，上限191,780辆
